voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Norton Disney, Lincolnshire, twenty twenty-three. Volunteers found, in a Roman pit, a hollow bronze object with twelve faces.
A round hole in every face, the holes of different sizes. A small knob on every corner. Complete, with no sign of wear.
Around a hundred and thirty are known, mostly from north-western Europe. None from Roman Italy.
The first on record turned up in Hertfordshire in seventeen thirty-nine. No Roman text or picture mentions them.
Theories include a knitting tool, a measuring device, a religious object. Their purpose has never been established.
